name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
summary: In Westfall's Dagger Hills, Grimbooze Thunderbrew keeps his casks and brews potent spirits. The eccentric dwarf speaks in verse and belongs to the Thunderbrew clan.

sections.title: A Brewer in Exile
sections.body: Grimbooze Thunderbrew keeps camp in the Dagger Hills, where he tends his private casks. He left the snowy peaks of Dun Morogh, home of the Thunderbrew brewing family in Kharanos, for Westfall's windswept hills. Jovial and devoted to potent spirits, he speaks only in rhymes. A traveler must complete a simple task before he answers questions, and he is ready to test a thirsty palate.

faq.q: Where can I find Grimbooze Thunderbrew?
faq.answer: Find Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Dagger Hills of southern Westfall. He keeps camp there with his brewing equipment.

faq.q: Why is Grimbooze speaking in rhymes?
aliases: why is he talking in verse
faq.answer: No one can say for certain why Grimbooze speaks in rhymes. He delights in verse and asks anyone with a question to complete a simple task first.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Thunderbrew Distillery?
faq.answer: Grimbooze belongs to the Thunderbrew clan of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. His kin, including Ragnar Thunderbrew, tend the family distillery at home, while Grimbooze brews on his own in the Westfall hills.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Thunderbrew name. Finding one of the Thunderbrew brothers brewing wild recipes in the Westfall hills brings a taste of Dun Morogh.
As a cook, you can learn from Grimbooze's brewing, part of the Thunderbrew legacy.
